<!-- @claude review -->
We appreciate your submitting a pull request to Verilator. On submitting the PR you are certifying this is your work product and you understand it; while AI can assist, you are expected to clean up AI text and changes, see [docs/CONTRIBUTING.rst](https://github.com/verilator/verilator/blob/master/docs/CONTRIBUTING.rst).

This automated message describes what is needed before your PR can be considered for merging. We ask that you make the PR as ready as possible, and then when you believe it is ready, or otherwise need help or feedback, comment to request review.
- Please address review feedback. When you have addressed a comment as the review requested, and have no further questions, please click "Resolve conversation" on each item in GitHub (please avoid "done" replies and other commentary only describing how it was resolved).
- If labeled `pr-blocked: needs-rebase`, please rebase or merge in master.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: fix-regression`, `pr-blocked: fix-rtlmeter` or `pr-blocked: fix-dev-coverage`, please fix the test failures.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: improve-coverage`, please improve developer code coverage to 100% of lines, see the coverage report comment.
- If labeled `pr-blocked: wait-for-other`, the PR is waiting for another issue or PR, see the comments. If it is no longer blocked, please comment.
- If the PR is a draft, please mark it ready when suitable for merge consideration.
- If have more than one round of pushes, please work on a personal branch with your own GitHub Actions runs, and only push to this PR when tests/coverage are resolved, to avoid unnecessary action runs and email that affect the entire community.

When all of these are addressed, or you have questions, please comment to (re-)request a review.  Due to the volume of PRs, we might only provide feedback or merge after you make a request comment.
